content_sections.heading: IIM Indore Research Associate Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The form asks for the following details: Your educational and professional qualifications, starting with the most recent. For each one, give the institution, the year of passing, the marks obtained out of the total marks, and the division and percentage. Your employment history, starting with the most recent job. For each job, give the company and location, your designation, whether the job was contractual or permanent, your responsibilities, your total monthly emoluments, the from and to dates, and the number of years. Your category (Unreserved, NCOBC, SC, ST or EWS), whether you belong to the PWD category, and your gender (Male, Female or Transgender). Check the official notification for the full eligibility for the Research Associate post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Indore Research Associate Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the application form for Recruitment Notification No. 07/2026 (link below). Fill in your personal information: your name (first, middle and last), your father's name, your date of birth (DD/MM/YY) and age in completed years, your marital status, category, PWD status, gender, address for communication, telephone numbers, mobile number and email. Fill in the qualification table and the employment table, starting with the most recent entry in each. Affix a recent photograph in the space given on the form. Sign and date the declaration. If any particulars are later found to be false, your candidature is liable to be cancelled without any reason being given. Email the completed form and the annexures to [email protected] by 9 November 2026. Attach these documents as PDF files:

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Associate posts are there at IIM Indore?
faq.answer: One. The notice advertises the Research Associate post under notification no. 07/2026 without printing a number, so it is counted as 1 vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. Can I send the application by post?
faq.answer: No. The notice says applications are accepted only through email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to email the application?
faq.answer: The form must reach [email protected] by 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. How should I attach my certificates?
faq.answer: As three separate PDF files. Put all qualification certificates in one file (Annexure-1), all experience certificates in another (Annexure-2), and any category and PwD certificates in a third (Annexure-3).

faq.question: Q5. Do I need a photograph on the form?
faq.answer: Yes. The form has a space where you affix a recent photograph.

faq.question: Q6. Which categories can I choose on the form?
faq.answer: Unreserved, NCOBC, SC, ST and EWS. The form also asks whether you belong to the PWD category.

faq.question: Q7. What happens if I give wrong details on the form?
faq.answer: Under the declaration you sign, your candidature is liable to be cancelled without any reason being given if any particulars are later found to be false.

faq.question: Q8. Where is IIM Indore located?
faq.answer: At Prabandh Shikhar, Rau-Pithampur Road, Indore 453556, Madhya Pradesh.
